A '''Voxwriter''' was a type of tool used by [[Holojournalist/Legends|holojournalists]] in their line of work. The [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Den Dhur]] used a small version that was no bigger than his thumb.<ref name="MedStar II">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>
